verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents funnel building with segmentation to 'answer why' (docs-5, docs-18) and links funnels to the exact sessions behind them (docs-31). Self-serve use is supported by its AI plain-language querying and 'no SQL… or waiting on the data team' claims (docs-10, docs-34), and by a community report of non-analysts across the whole team using its simple UX (comm-1). missing for 10: explicit documentation of step-by-step drop-off/conversion analysis in funnels, in-depth first-party funnel docs beyond one-line claims, hands-on corroboration of a founder identifying the losing activation step.
